articles.title: Shipments of foreign-branded phones in China up 9.2% y/y in February, says CAICT-Reuters
articles.content: Shipments of foreign-branded smartphones, including Apple Inc's iPhone, in China rose 9.2% in February year-on-year, according to Reuters calculations based on data released on Monday from a government-affiliated research firm.
